class A:
 def __repr__(self): return "representation"
 def __str__(self): return "display"
print(repr(A()),str(A()),A())

class A:
 def __repr__(self): return "representation"
a=A()
print(str(a),a,repr(a))

class A:
 def __repr__(self): return "type-repr"
 def __str__(self): return "type-str"
a=A()
def local(): return "local"
a.__repr__=local
a.__str__=local
print(a.__repr__(),a.__str__(),repr(a),str(a))

class A:
 def __repr__(self): return "base"
class B(A):
 def __repr__(self): return "before"
b=B()
old=b.__repr__
def changed(self): return "after"
B.__repr__=changed
print(repr(b),old())
del B.__repr__
print(repr(b),str(b))

class A:
 def __repr__(self): return 7
 def __str__(self): return None
a=A()
print(a.__repr__(),a.__str__())

text="value😀"
class A:
 def __str__(self): return text
 def __repr__(self): return text
print(str(A()) is text,repr(A()) is text)
